metaDescription: Check 2026 Türkiye visa-free rules for US, UK, EU, Canada and Gulf passports, official evisa.gov.tr warnings, 150-day validity and 90/180 rules.
quickAnswer: In 2026, ordinary passport holders from the UK, US, Canada, Australia, nearly all EU states, and all six GCC Gulf countries enter Türkiye visa-free for up to 90 days in 180 days ([MFA](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa)). Nationalities still needing an e-Visa must apply only at [evisa.gov.tr](https://evisa.gov.tr/register/) and carry at least 150 days of passport validity.

body.text: Entry rules for Türkiye shifted significantly in recent years, yet outdated blogs and aggressive third-party agencies still charge visa-exempt travelers $80–$120 for documents they do not need. Always confirm your passport rules directly against the [Republic of Türkiye Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa) schedule.
Which nationalities enter Türkiye visa-free for 90 days in 2026?

Ordinary passport holders from the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, all six Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) states (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman), and the vast majority of European Union member states enter Türkiye visa-free for tourism up to 90 days in any 180-day window.

body.text: These exemptions cover tourism and short business visits on ordinary passports only; work, study, and journalism still require consular visas via [www.visa.gov.tr](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/general-information-about-turkish-visas.en.mfa).
Who still needs an official e-Visa and how do you avoid scam sites?

Travelers holding ordinary passports from countries such as China (PRC) ([Turkish Embassy Beijing](https://beijing-emb.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowAnnouncement/411690)), Vietnam, Mexico, and South Africa, as well as conditional-eligibility nationals like India (who must hold a valid US, UK, Ireland, or Schengen visa or residence permit per the [Turkish Embassy in New Delhi](https://newdelhi-emb.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowAnnouncement/361514)), still require an electronic visa before boarding.
Copycat sites buy top search ads and charge two to four times the government fee—or issue invalid PDFs. Follow four strict rules:

items: Use only .gov.tr: The sole official portal is [evisa.gov.tr](https://evisa.gov.tr/register/) (FAQs at [evisa.gov.tr/faq](https://evisa.gov.tr/faq/)). Avoid every .com or .org lookalike.
Check if you are already exempt: Unscrupulous brokers still bill US, UK, Canadian, and Australian citizens who need no visa.

Carry original supporting visas: Airlines and border officers inspect physical US/UK/Schengen visas on arrival ([Turkish Embassy New Delhi](https://newdelhi-emb.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowAnnouncement/361514)).
Apply 72 hours early: Never leave payment or downloads to airport check-in.

body.text: What passport validity (150 days vs 6 months) is enforced at border control?

Under Article 7.1b of Law No. 6458, your passport must remain valid for at least 60 days beyond the duration of stay granted by your visa or exemption ([MFA Passport Validity Rules](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/passport-validity-requirements-while-entering-turkey-in-accordance-with-law-on-foreigners-and-international-protection.en.mfa)). For a 90-day visa-free entry, the strict legal minimum at border control is 150 days (90 + 60 days) from arrival.

Even so, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs advises holding at least 6 months of validity on arrival, and many airlines enforce a flat 6-month boarding cutoff. If your passport sits between 5 and 6 months, renew before flying, and keep at least one blank page for stamps.
How does the 90-in-180-day rule work for repeat visits?

Türkiye enforces a rolling 180-day lookback, not a calendar-year reset. On any day you enter or remain in Türkiye, border control counts backward 180 days; your total cumulative days spent inside the country during that rolling window cannot exceed 90 days, including both arrival and departure dates.

A quick ferry to Greece or flight to Georgia does not reset your clock. If you stayed 60 days in spring and return in summer, you have only 30 days left until earlier spring days roll off the 180-day window. Overstaying triggers fines at passport control and potential re-entry bans.

faq.q: Do US and Canadian citizens need an e-Visa for Türkiye in 2026?
faq.a: No. Ordinary US and Canadian passport holders enter visa-free for up to 90 days within any 180-day period ([MFA](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa)).

faq.q: Do UK and EU citizens need a visa to visit Türkiye?
faq.a: UK citizens and nearly all EU nationals enter visa-free for 90 days in 180 days. Republic of Cyprus passport holders should check current rules on [mfa.gov.tr](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa).

faq.q: Do cruise passengers stopping in Kuşadası or Istanbul need a visa?
faq.a: Cruise passengers arriving and departing on the same ship are generally visa-exempt for up to 72 hours with port security permission; confirm with your cruise line.

faq.q: Can I enter Türkiye with an expired European passport?
faq.a: Although narrow bilateral rules exist for select European states ([MFA](https://www.mfa.gov.tr/general-information-about-turkish-visas.en.mfa)), airlines routinely deny boarding on expired passports—always travel with a valid document.

faq.q: What if I want to stay longer than 90 days?
faq.a: Apply for a short-term residence permit (ikamet) with Turkish migration authorities before your 90 days expire; border runs do not reset tourist limits.

faq.q: Should I print my e-Visa if my nationality requires one?
faq.a: Yes. Carry a printed paper copy alongside a phone PDF, as departure check-in desks regularly inspect hard copies.
